text:
jen: Kicking off night-bridge deploy. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Pin US to v3.2.1 for 1 hour, EU soft-roll 10%, APAC smoke-only. Need capacity checks + stoplight from infra/SRE.

deploy-bot: queued deploy: us:v3.2.1 (pin=1h). To start run: `/deploy region=us image=v3.2.1 pin=1h`. Status: queued.

sam: Running quick capacity smoke for US. ETA ~2m.

marco: US capacity headroom = 28% (≈100k token slots free), avg p90 latency 62ms. Can sustain ~20% traffic bump for 15m without autoscale.

aisha: EU cluster warmup in progress. Current headroom 12% — recommend we keep EU at 10% slice until US telemetry stable.

jen: Copy that. EU stays at 10%. Rollback triggers: US latency p90 >100ms OR 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m => rollback.

marco: Setting stoplight dashboard now: US=green, EU=amber, APAC=standby. Will paste link when ready.

marco: https://console.redwood/stoplight/1767012345 (dashboard link, live telemetry).

deploy-bot: US rollout started: canary=5% -> 25% -> full. Canary check window = 10m.

sam: Canary smoke looks clean. Throughput nominal, no 5xx. p95 latency steady. CPU on p2 hosts spiked ~10% but within threshold.

aisha: Toggling KV prefix cache on for US canary to reduce cold-starts.

jen: Nice. If green at T+25m we bump EU to 20% and kick APAC dry-run (no pin, no traffic shift).

sam: ALERT: observed latency tail ~420ms on a small subset of requests in US. Investigating; reverting canary back to 5% now.

marco: Draining one host showing abnormal kernel selection. Reverting canary -> 5% completed. Initiating host drain and kernel re-eval.

jen: Good catch. Hold EU at 10%, pause APAC dry-run. Update release notes for #releases: v3.2.1 pinned in US, rollback rules documented, change window 02:00-05:00 UTC.

sam: Rollback executed successfully, no request-level errors attributed. Monitoring for 10m.

aisha: Note for postmortem: root cause appears to be quantization flag mismatch that led to suboptimal kernel path. Patch in review, target next canary.

jen: Plan: wait for kernel patch and one warm rebuild before resuming EU escalation. Leaving pins/holdpoints as-is for night. Thanks team :thumbsup:
